access_token.description: Asana personal access token, sent as a Bearer token (Authorization: Bearer <access_token>). Never logged.

base_url.description: Asana API base URL override for tests or proxies.

workspace_id.description: Optional Asana workspace gid; scopes the 'projects' and 'tasks' streams to this workspace when set.

project_id.description: Optional Asana project gid; scopes the 'tasks' stream to this project when set.

assignee.description: Optional Asana assignee gid; scopes the 'tasks' stream to this assignee when set.

team_id.description: Optional Asana team gid; scopes the 'team_memberships' stream to this team when set (Asana requires either team, or workspace+user, on that endpoint).

goal_id.description: Optional Asana goal gid used by source-backed goal-scoped full-refresh streams.

portfolio_id.description: Optional Asana portfolio gid used by source-backed portfolio-scoped full-refresh streams.

task_id.description: Optional Asana task gid used by source-backed task-scoped full-refresh streams.

user_id.description: Optional Asana user gid used by source-backed user-scoped full-refresh streams.

section_id.description: Optional Asana section gid used by the source-backed section task collection stream.

tag_id.description: Optional Asana tag gid used by the source-backed tag task collection stream.

user_task_list_id.description: Optional Asana user task list gid used by its source-backed task collection stream.

time_tracking_category_id.description: Optional Asana time tracking category gid used by its source-backed entry collection stream.

parent_id.description: Optional exact source parent identifier used by attachment and status-update collection requests.

supported_goal_id.description: Optional Asana goal gid required by the source-backed goal relationship collection request.

emoji_base.description: Optional provider-documented emoji base required by the source-backed reactions collection request.

target_id.description: Optional provider-documented target identifier required by the source-backed reactions collection request.

favorite_resource_type.description: Optional provider-documented resource type required by the source-backed user favorites collection request.

organization_id.description: Optional Asana organization gid required by the source-backed teams-for-user collection request.

mode.description: Runtime mode: live (default) or fixture for credential-free conformance.
